description: Three cohorts - victimised as adults, victimised as children, and not affected. All three, including the unaffected, reported elevated depression, PTSD symptom severity and sleep disturbance. The cohorts were not genetically related.
energy_note: The unexposed cohort had it too.

aspect: Which means the community is the medium
description: Shared narrative, commemoration, economic damage, stigma, a damaged health system and a population of visibly injured adults. A child growing up inside that acquires the outcome without any biological inheritance.
energy_note: You catch it from the town, not the parent.

description: Unlike a germline change, a social mechanism can be addressed - by services, recognition, economic repair and treatment of the exposed generation. This is the most actionable finding in the dataset.

aspect: Economic transmission is the least discussed channel
description: A family that lost property, savings and a breadwinner transmits that to children as reduced education, worse housing and no capital. The mental health outcome follows from the economics without anything mystical.
energy_note: Inherited poverty, wearing a psychiatric label.
